system.summary: Office codes of the Continental Congress: a numbered code of some 670 groups (Franklin editors' Cipher No. 4; 19 the, 141 be, 379 to, 495 will, 606 of, 597 France) for Livingston 1781 and the 1782 resolves; Thomson-Jay dictionary code (page.word) for 1780; Lovell's keyword column cipher for the 1781 report.
system.notes: Several systems in one file; key sheets (Lovell, Dumas, Dana, Franklin, Adams/Laurens/Jay alphabets) are filed with them (images 95-122). Not decoded here.

solution.what: NARA proxy API: file unit 2124632 children listed; vol. 1 (naId 475671573, 422 images) and vol. 2 (314) imaged; Fold3 object descriptions filtered for cipher pieces: 7 communications and ~12 key sheets in vol. 1, none in vol. 2.

Vol. 1 images 93-140 and 313-325 viewed: the cipher pieces are encipherment worksheets and file copies with English under or beside the groups; the 'fragment to Franklin' is pp. 169-172, its first half pp. 325-328 bound elsewhere.

Worksheet phrases matched to Livingston to Franklin, 26 Nov 1781, Papers of Benjamin Franklin 36 (Founders Online); Committee to Jay 16 June 1780 in Jay Papers 2; Thomson 19 May 1780 dictionary cypher decoded in Jay's hand at Columbia.

Livingston worksheet English compared with the edition passage by passage: agrees except p. 171 'one Month's continuance' (group 190) vs edition 'one years'; zoomed crop confirms the worksheet reading.

outcome.method_basis: Every cipher piece carries its English on the page (encipherment worksheets and attested copies) or is printed in the Franklin and Jay editions and the Journals; found before any decoding, and nothing was decoded here.
outcome.notes: Catalogue 631 removed. The undescribed 'fragment to B. Franklin' identified as Livingston's 26 Nov 1781 letter, its first half found at pp. 325-328; one variant against the Franklin edition recorded (Month's / years). No write-up.

texts.label: Livingston to Franklin, 26 Nov 1781 (PCC 59 i pp. 325-328, 169-172)
texts.summary: Lafayette carries the letter; France must not stop her hand now: public credit would drop, the contracts for the next campaign be given up, troops promised pay in specie grow discontented; total abolition of paper money and the arrears of debt leave Congress unable to exert itself without money; less than one month's (edition: year's) continuance of the war would cost France as much; ask whether Deane's intercepted letters were published in Europe.
texts.note: Decryption: the English on the worksheet and the Franklin edition (linked, not copied). Not transcribed.

reading_review.note: The worksheet's English read as sentences on the images and checked against the edition; one variant noted.
